title: Restore removed reports
text: A removed analytics report stays in the recycle area for 7 days before permanent deletion.

title: How long can I recover a deleted analytics report — Europe
text: A deleted analytics report can be recovered for 14 days in a Europe Team workspace.

title: How long can I recover a deleted analytics report — Asia Pacific
text: A deleted analytics report can be recovered for 21 days in an Asia Pacific Team workspace.

title: How long can I recover a deleted analytics report — United States
text: A deleted analytics report can be recovered for 30 days in a United States Enterprise workspace.

title: How long can I recover a deleted analytics report — archived
text: A deleted analytics report can be recovered for 90 days under the retired 2024 policy.

title: Download activity records
text: The standard activity download is supplied as a CSV file with one event per row.

title: Which file format does the audit export use — Europe
text: The audit export uses a JSON Lines file for Europe Team workspaces.

title: Which file format does the audit export use — Asia Pacific
text: The audit export uses a parquet file for Asia Pacific Team workspaces.

title: Which file format does the audit export use — United States
text: The audit export uses a signed ZIP archive of CSV files for United States Enterprise workspaces.

title: Which file format does the audit export use — archived
text: The audit export uses an XML file under the retired 2024 export service.

title: Share with a guest
text: A guest sharing link stops working 24 hours after it is created on the Free plan.

title: When does a guest sharing link expire — Europe
text: A guest sharing link expires after 72 hours in a Europe Team workspace.

title: When does a guest sharing link expire — Asia Pacific
text: A guest sharing link expires after 48 hours in an Asia Pacific Team workspace.

title: When does a guest sharing link expire — United States
text: A guest sharing link expires after 7 days in a United States Enterprise workspace.

title: When does a guest sharing link expire — archived
text: A guest sharing link expires after 30 days under the retired 2024 sharing policy.

title: Store records for offline work
text: Offline sync can queue 200 record changes on the Free plan and uploads them after reconnection.

title: How many records can offline sync store — Europe
text: Offline sync can store 2,000 records in a Europe Team workspace.

title: How many records can offline sync store — Asia Pacific
text: Offline sync can store 1,500 records in an Asia Pacific Team workspace.

title: How many records can offline sync store — United States
text: Offline sync can store 10,000 records in a United States Enterprise workspace.

title: How many records can offline sync store — archived
text: Offline sync can store 50,000 records under the retired desktop client policy.

title: Download an invoice receipt
text: Free-plan administrators can download an invoice tax receipt from Billing, then Payment history.

title: Where can I download the invoice tax receipt — Europe
text: Download the invoice tax receipt from Billing, Tax documents in a Europe Team workspace.

title: Where can I download the invoice tax receipt — Asia Pacific
text: Download the invoice tax receipt from Billing, Regional documents in an Asia Pacific Team workspace.

title: Where can I download the invoice tax receipt — United States
text: Download the invoice tax receipt from Billing, Compliance archive in a United States Enterprise workspace.

title: Where can I download the invoice tax receipt — archived
text: Download the invoice tax receipt from Account, Legacy invoices under the retired 2024 menu.

title: Sign in again after inactivity
text: A Free-plan user is signed out after 8 hours without activity.

title: When does an inactive sign-in session end — Europe
text: An inactive sign-in session ends after 2 hours in a Europe Team workspace.

title: When does an inactive sign-in session end — Asia Pacific
text: An inactive sign-in session ends after 4 hours in an Asia Pacific Team workspace.

title: When does an inactive sign-in session end — United States
text: An inactive sign-in session ends after 30 minutes in a United States Enterprise workspace.

title: When does an inactive sign-in session end — archived
text: An inactive sign-in session ends after 24 hours under the retired 2024 security policy.
